description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended Elacestrant as an option for treating oestrogen receptor (ER)- positive HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with an activating ESR1 mutation that has progressed after at least 1 line of endocrine treatment plus a cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4 and 6 inhibitor in: the cancer has progressed after at least 12 months of endocrine treatment plus a CDK 4 and 6 inhibitor, and It is only recommended if women, trans men and non-binary people who have been through the menopause; trans women and men. Elacestrant is recommended only if:; the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
